opportunities.name: Movie lookup (IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes) and email a movie-night invite
opportunities.description: Look up a movie on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, collect director, runtime and ratings, then compose an email invite with those details.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open the title page
Note director, runtime and IMDb rating
Search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open the page
Note the Tomatometer score
Open a new mail message
Enter recipient in To
Enter 'Movie night <day>: <title>' as Subject
Enter body with director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer
Discard the draft

opportunities.name: npm package lookup, GitHub releases, and note
opportunities.description: Search an npm package, open its page and GitHub repo releases, and save a stats summary note.
steps: Search the package name on npm and press Enter
Open the package page
Note version, weekly downloads, license
Open the GitHub repo link and then Releases
Note stars, open issues and last release date
Add a note with the summary in the Notes app
